title: Ranveer Singh's Apocalyptic Thriller Pralay Goes on Floors in Mumbai
excerpt: The end-of-the-world action film, directed by Jai Mehta and produced by Birla Studios, begins shooting at live locations across Mumbai.
body:
• Ranveer Singh's end-of-the-world action thriller Pralay has officially begun filming in Mumbai.
  • The film is directed by Jai Mehta, who co-directed the acclaimed Scam 1992 and directed Lootere.
  • Ranveer serves as both lead actor and producer on the project, marking another ambitious bet after the record-breaking Dhurandhar franchise.
  • Lokah breakout star Kalyani Priyadarshan joins the cast in a pivotal role.

From Dhurandhar to the End of the World

https://youtube.com/watch?v=fQR91cd7rsE

Ranveer Singh's next major motion picture has officially entered production. Pralay, an end-of-the-world action thriller, went on floors in Mumbai this week, marking the start of what the makers are calling one of Indian cinema's most ambitious projects currently in development.

The film comes on the heels of Singh's career-defining run with Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar The Revenge, which became the highest-grossing Indian film of all time. With Pralay, the actor ventures into entirely new cinematic territory — a survival epic set against the terrifying possibility of global catastrophe.

Singh is not just headlining the film but also serving as a producer, signaling the level of creative investment he has in the project. The story demands both physical intensity and emotional conviction, according to the production team.

A Director with a Track Record for Grit

Behind the camera is Jai Mehta, whose work on Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story — co-directed with Hansal Mehta — and the series Lootere has earned him a reputation for taut, gripping storytelling. With Pralay, Mehta makes his leap into large-scale theatrical filmmaking.

https://x.com/rameshlaus/status/2088869432831717701

The film plunges audiences into a relentless survival odyssey set against Mumbai's unmistakable pulse and landscape. At its heart is a journey of courage and the instinct to fight for what matters most when the world begins to collapse. Rather than relying on studio sets, the production is shooting at live locations in and around Mumbai, embracing the physicality and unpredictability of real-world environments to bring heightened scale, texture, and realism to the story.

"Pralay is an original story that seeks to marry breathtaking spectacle with a deeply human emotional core."

— Production statement

A New Generation of Talent

Joining Singh in a pivotal role is Kalyani Priyadarshan, who broke out with her performance in Lokah. Her casting further underlines the film's intention to bring together an exciting new generation of talent alongside established star power.

The production is backed by Birla Studios, with Ananya Birla positioning the venture as a reflection of her ambition to push the landscape of Indian cinema as a creative catalyst. Hansal Mehta and Sahil Saigal's True Story Films are co-producing, bringing their track record of content-driven disruption to the project.

Pralay had been in highly technical and intensive pre-production for several months before cameras rolled. The makers have assembled an ensemble of creative and technical talent from India and around the world, though specific details about the VFX and technical teams remain under wraps.

No release date has been announced, but with filming now underway, the production is expected to target a 2027 theatrical window.
